node.title: Re^2: Perl 6 to be renamed? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think there is a ticket somewhere in some bug tracker on renaming Perl 6, but I can't find it at the moment.

It's here: [https://github.com/perl6/problem-solving/issues/81|"Perl" in the name "Perl 6" is confusing and irritating]. Note the [https://github.com/perl6/problem-solving/issues/81#issuecomment-520216578|comment further down] by [TheDamian] (GitHub user "thoughtstream") regarding [id://1226012|the "Raku" name]. And just today I ran across a post somewhere (I can't find it right now) arguing in favor of keeping the Perl 6 name. So I think basically it's still in discussion.

Of course, the language might just end up being [https://youtu.be/tenl6JEum5k?t=29966|named "Whatever"] ;-)

Update: [liz] starts talking about it at [https://youtu.be/tx44bh6lP1Q?t=2710|this point] in the talk.

Update 2: The discussion is also in [https://github.com/perl6/problem-solving/pull/89|this pull request].
